intermedin (IM), a member of the adrenomodullin (AM) peptide family, inhibits GHRH-stimulation of growth hormone (GH) release from cultured, dispersed anterior pituitaries cells, but fails to significantly alter basal GH, ACTH or prolactin secretion or the stimulatory effects of CRH or TRH on ACTH and prolactin, respectively.
